description: Angular component for a SCADA symbol metadata tag function panel, handling user input for render functions or click actions, with associated UI logic and event handling.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolMetadataTagFunctionPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing SCADA symbol metadata tag functions, including UI interactions and logic for different function types.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group, sets panel title, arguments, highlight rules, and help ID based on the function type.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets focus to the tag function component after view initialization.

methods.name: applyTagFunction
methods.description: Emits the current tag function value when applied.
